caption: The drawing depicts a detailed technical illustration of a table shown in two views: a front elevation on the left and a side elevation on the right. The table features ornate, decorative carvings, predominantly on its apron and legs, with scrolling patterns and intricate motifs. The front view displays the overall width of 48½ inches and a height of 23½ inches from the ground to the top surface, while the depth seen in the side view is 23¾ inches. Both views show the curved legs with carved details, and the apron includes elaborate floral and shell-like designs. There is a small rectangular detail at the top right showing an enlarged decorative motif. Dimensions are marked in inches, and a scale in feet is provided at the bottom left. The drawing is made using black ink lines on a tan or yellowed paper background.
title: Pier Table
